root_cause: A recovery node could remain anchored to the SHA that was current when promotion started even after protected main advanced.
An expired Netlify write proxy/transport could be treated as a user-visible waiting state instead of a recoverable transport fault.
Provider truth was not always re-read before and after a transport retry.
prevention: Resolve current protected main and current Netlify production before any retry.
Accept only repository-proven safe supersession when the originally expected SHA is no longer current.
Reacquire expired authorized Netlify transport once, then provider-readback before another write.
Never return a pending production state as final while autonomous recovery remains possible.
Re-resolve main after transport recovery because the target may have advanced.
